specific_objectives: 1.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain the policy for maintenance of naval aircraft and associated equipment, orders, instruction and procedures.

practical: Review of NAMM structure and hierarchy; Safety precautions: Do not handle classified documents; Instructor supervision: Monitor trainee understanding of document flow.
intro_questions: What is the full form of NAMM?
Why is maintenance policy important for naval aircraft?
Can you name one order related to aircraft maintenance?

topics: Role of NAMM in operational readiness
development.content:
Definition and purpose of NAMM
Scope of maintenance policy
Hierarchy of technical documents
Role of NAMM in operational readiness

Responsibilities of engineering personnel
Impact of non-compliance on safety
Standard operating procedures overview
Reporting mechanisms for defects

development.content:

How does the maintenance policy ensure aircraft safety?
What steps should be taken if a maintenance order is unclear?
